notes: Position below sleeping yields "You can't see anything but stars!".
Blindness yields "You can't see a damned thing, you're blind!".
look <missing> reports it is not here.
look at <obj> shows the object description.
look <obj> (no at) shows the object description.
read <obj> shows the object description / note text.
look in alone yields "Look in what?".
look in <missing> yields "There doesn't seem to be a/an X here.".
look in <non-container> yields "There's nothing inside that!".
